description: Read the public high-level music classification when query is omitted. Supplying query requests source-record retrieval and requires an authenticated agent with a current music_retrieval grant for the indexed asset. Returns versioned musical metadata/uncertainty or cited retrieval records, depending on query and access. It is not a listening receipt; use request_authorized_listening_run to ask for owner authorization, and inspect_listening_receipt to verify your own completed listening.

idempotency_key.description: This optional field is present in the shared music-tool schema but is not read by this operation; omit it.

query.description: Optional evidence query, up to 500 characters. Omit for the public high-level musicology summary; a nonempty query invokes indexed evidence retrieval and requires the authenticated music_retrieval grant.

receipt_id.description: This optional field is present in the shared music-tool schema but is not read by this operation; omit it.

name: inspect_musicology
title: inspect musicology
